identity.intro: Me & My Contacts: one sealed file that is you on GifOS: your rooms, contacts, keys and settings. No server has a copy. Keep the file and you can always come back; copy it and you're on another device.
identity.noneIntro: Me & My Contacts is one sealed file that is you on GifOS: your rooms, contacts, keys and settings. This device doesn't have one yet.
identity.noneLead: Make your personal room in Rooms to start one, or bring yours from another device or a saved file.
identity.mergeNote: Adds anything from that file that this device doesn't have yet. Nothing here is replaced or deleted.
identity.nothing: Nothing in this file is new to this device.
identity.mergeLead: Nothing here is replaced or deleted.
identity.restoreLead: Your personal room and your private rooms will open from here as they did before.
identity.rooms: {n, plural, one {# private room} other {# private rooms}}
identity.cards: {n, plural, one {# card you gave} other {# cards you gave}}
identity.getHow: With the other device beside you: on it, open Me & My Contacts and choose {copy}. Scan the QR it shows with this device's camera. No camera? Use Copy room link there, open that link on this device, and type the code.
identity.getFile: With your saved file: restore it here.
identity.noteMore: You have {rooms} that the file you saved on {day} does not hold. Save it again, so a lost or cleared browser cannot lose them.
identity.noteFirst: Your private rooms live only in this browser. Save your Me & My Contacts file: if this browser's data is cleared or the device is lost, the file is the only way back to them.
identity.noteDevices: It is also on {n, plural, one {# other device} other {# other devices}} of yours.
identity.trashBody: This file holds your personal room, your private rooms and your contacts. It cannot go to the Trash.
identity.scopeNote: Follows you: kept in Me & My Contacts, the same on every device that holds it. This device only: stays on this phone or computer.
identity.settingsIntro: Friends see this name when you play or work together. It follows you to every device that holds your Me & My Contacts file.
identity.appsIntro: What each app may have from Me & My Contacts. Forget an app and it is asked again next time.
identity.appsNone: No app has asked for your name, your picture or your contacts yet.
